title: AgentDeploymentTransition
description: RFC 0082 §E. The request body of POST /agents/{agentId}/deployments — a deployment state-transition request. The host authorizes it fail-closed against the RFC 0049 `deploy:*` scope, runs any configured RFC 0051 approvalGate, enforces the RFC 0081 eval evidence when the gate requires it, and on success emits the matching `deployment.*` event and returns the updated `agent-deployment.schema.json` record. Carries no manifest body or credential material (SR-1).

version.description: The concrete agent-definition version the transition targets (matches `AgentManifest.version`).

transition.description: The lifecycle operation. `promote`: move exactly one step forward (draft→test→staged→active, over the advertised states), or resume paused→active. `pause`: active→paused. `deprecate`: active→deprecated. `rollback`: active→rolled-back, restoring the version that was active on the same channel immediately before. `adjust-canary`: change the active version's `canaryPercent`. The legal transitions are normative in `spec/v2/facets/agents.schema.json` §deployment (RFC 0254); an illegal one is `409 deployment_state_conflict`.

toState.description: MAY. For `promote`, the target state. Absent means the next state. Present, it MUST equal the next state, or the host refuses it `409 deployment_state_conflict`. A host MUST reject a transition into a state it does not advertise in `capabilities.agents.deployment.states` with `400 validation_error`, checked before the state machine.

channel.description: MAY. The named deployment channel this transition targets (e.g. `stable`). The version becomes resolvable by `AgentRef.channel` = this value (RFC 0082 §A/§B).

canaryPercent.description: MAY. For `promote` to `active` or `adjust-canary`, the share of channel traffic this version takes. A host advertising `capabilities.agents.deployment.canary: false` MUST reject any value < 100.

evalRunId.description: MAY. The RFC 0081 eval run whose `EvalSummary.passed` the gate verifies before emitting `deployment.promoted` (the §E evidence). Required when the target `approvalGate` is configured with `requiredEval`; an unmet eval gate is rejected with `eval_gate_unmet`.

reason.description: MAY. A short redaction-safe reason label (NOT free-text content), surfaced on `deployment.rolled-back.reason`. Same posture as `run.dead_lettered.reason`.
